verdict.rationale: Linear ships a built-in "Linear Agent" that users can delegate issues to via assignment or @mention, which writes code (Claude Code/Codex), edits text, runs coding sessions in the cloud, tests its work, and reports back in-app — this is documented extensively across the changelog and agents docs (e.g. linear-docs-21, 25, 41, 43, 54, 68). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation beyond first-party docs.
